Pull the crown out fully to Click 2 (second click). The second hand will stop.

Rotate the crown clockwise to advance the main hands.

Continue rotating the hands past 12 midnight repeatedly until the Day sub-dial points to the correct day.

Check the 24-Hour sub-dial at the bottom to determine AM or PM.

Set the main hands to your exact local time while ensuring the 24-hour indicator matches correctly. For example, at 8:00 PM, the 24-hour hand should point to 20.

Step 2: Set the Date Sub-Dial

Push the crown completely in, then pull it out gently to Click 1.

Rotate the crown counter-clockwise to advance the Date sub-dial.

Continue turning until the date hand points to the correct date.

Push the crown all the way back in to resume normal timekeeping.
